levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن جعفر الحميري
عبد الله بن عبد الرحمن الأصم

notes: The opening «وبهذا الإسناد» takes prev1's chain (has_written_chain true): its first level and عبد الله بن جعفر are inherited, then the report writes موسى بن عمر onward again, so those are its own links
The second isnad after the saying («وحدثني ... وذكر مثله») is a second group, written in full
Needs a ruling: the Imam (أبي عبد الله) is in the narrated scene, speaks and acts (rule 11); the chain ends at معاوية بن وهب who tells it, the Imam is not written
The Imam's words are inside the matn, so the Imam is not a link of this reading
